The match was held at [[Croke Park]], [[Dublin]], on 6 September 1936, between [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] and [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]]. The Leinster champions lost to their Munster opponents on a score line of 5–6 to 1–5.{{cite book |last=Bellew |first=Ronnie |last2=Crowe |first2=Dermot |date=2014 |title=Hell for Leather: A Journey Through Hurling in 100 Games |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Hell_for_Leather/wjfuBQAAQBAJ |publisher=[[Hachette Books]] |isbn=9781444789928 |access-date=May 20, 2025}} {{TOC left}} {{Clear}} ==Match details== {{football box |date=1936-09-06
